72. Participation directions can:
• Prevent a party or witness from seeing another party or witness.
• Allow a party or witness to participate/give evidence by live link.
• Provide for use of a device to help communication.
• Provide for the assistance of an intermediary.
• Deal with the structure and timing of the hearing, the formality of language to be used in
court and whether the parties should attend court via different entrances and use different
waiting areas.
